note: v0.48 planets. Every planet is the same size (16 384 m around) and uses the same generator; a profile shifts the continents (phase), the share of sea (sea_bias), the height of the ranges (mountain), the climate (temperature °C and water added everywhere), ore richness (hematite multiplier), and the colours (soil and sky tints, globe tint). Earth's profile is today's values exactly.

earth.name: 地球
earth.title: 蓝色星球
earth.description: 大洋、大陆和两极冰盖；起始河湾所在的家园星球。

ember.name: 赤砂星
ember.title: 红色荒漠行星
ember.description: 更热、更干：陆地连成大片荒漠，海洋只剩零星的内海；山脉更高更陡。地壳富含赤铁矿，是炼铁的好去处。
